description: United States Navy transport used in Iceland on search and transport duties. Dismantled and moved to the aviation heritage collection at Hnjótur on 21 September 2002 and displayed outdoors.
Soviet-built single-engine biplane that landed at Örlygshöfn in 1993 and remained in Iceland. Displayed outdoors at the museum.
Nose section only. Former Iscargo and Fragtflug airliner held at Hnjótur and stored rather than formally exhibited.
